Technical hidden construction is an inference, not an author-confirmed design.
Render ONLY ONE front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait, square frame, same camera and face size as other expression assets. The expression is gentle small natural smile, eyes open. Both ears and upper hairstyle fully visible with a small margin, shoulders at bottom; keep the source hair ornaments and upper clothing. No hands, text, tears effects, bubbles or extra heads. This expression is newly generated, not from the original author.
